content_html:
Conformance exercise for gate G11 (decision #57, blygger-studio 0.20.0): a pinned thread carrying a remote quote, to be forked on the other node, where the quote must arrive flattened rather than as a directive.

People who want a more stable, fast version may want to use aneesh’s client. The reference studio client will have more feature completeness but will also move fast and break things.

New version of blygger-desktop is up

The auto-updater should download it. if not, check for updates in the main Blygger menu or in Help>About

If you haven't updated since 0.3, you will need to redownload. See instructions: https://github.com/aneeshsathe/blygger-desktop

— quoted from blyg.aneeshsathe.com · v1

— quoted from venkateshrao.com · v1

The quote above is from venkateshrao.com.
